dct_title_s: Water Distribution System, Points - City of Newton
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This data layer contains data for various types of point features, including water valves, meter pits, blow offs, pump stations, and water towers of Newton's water distribution system. A second, related layer (Water Distribution System, Lines) includes data for system mains and pipes.

Purpose: This layer is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. This layer will provide a basemap for layers related to utilities and municipal engineering purposes as well as urban planning or public works purposes (including defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output.)

Supplemental information: The city will be maintaining this data layer using information from city crews and from contractor crews. The current intent is for this maintenance to be performed using the V7ARC application purchased from Hansen, Inc. At this time that application is not working correctly, and maintenance is not occurring.
